format: 2 shorts per day; every 3 days compile 6 shorts into one long video

episodes.title: Beep Gets Stuck in Mud
story: Beep races down a muddy village road and splashes through a puddle.
His wheels sink into a deep mud patch and spin faster and faster.
Reddy arrives with a tow rope and tries to pull Beep free.
Dumpy pushes from behind, but pushes too hard and lands in the same mud.
Reddy carefully pulls both friends out and they celebrate together.
episodes.ending_twist: Dumpy laughs at Beep, then gets stuck too.

episodes.title: The Giant Pothole
story: The Road Engineer discovers a huge pothole blocking the school road.
Dumpy brings gravel while Tracto levels the loose ground.
Reddy keeps traffic safely stopped and guides the team.
Dumpy accidentally dumps a little too much gravel and creates a funny mountain.
The team spreads it flat and the repaired road opens with a happy horn parade.
episodes.ending_twist: The gravel pile becomes a tiny ramp and Beep does a harmless little hop.

episodes.title: Tracto Saves the Dry Farm
story: Farmer Uncle sees droopy plants under the hot sun.
Tracto opens irrigation rows while Dumpy brings fresh soil.
Beep rushes to fetch a small water trailer.
Beep turns too quickly and gives everyone a giant splash.
The water reaches the field, the plants perk up, and Farmer Uncle smiles.
episodes.ending_twist: The rescue water sprays Tracto first, making him blink and laugh.

episodes.title: Tiny Car, Big Hill
story: Little Kid cheers as Beep tries to climb a steep dirt hill.
Beep makes it halfway, slips backward, and gets scared.
Towy attaches a safe tow line while Reddy spots from below.
Beep tries again slowly with Towy helping just enough.
They reach the top together and Little Kid waves proudly.
episodes.ending_twist: At the top, Beep honks too loudly and startles himself.

episodes.title: Reddy's Rainy Rescue
story: Heavy rain makes a bend in the road slippery.
Driver Mom stops safely after her small car slides onto the soft shoulder.
Reddy blocks the lane with warning lights while Towy connects a tow line.
Beep arrives carrying safety cones but drops one that rolls away comically.
The car is pulled back onto the road and everyone leaves safely.
episodes.ending_twist: The runaway cone stops perfectly beside Beep like he planned it.

episodes.title: Dumpy Builds a Tiny Bridge
story: A small farm stream washes out the old wooden crossing.
Road Engineer plans a short safe replacement.
Dumpy brings stone, Tracto levels the base, and Reddy carries tools.
Dumpy accidentally drops one rock into the water and gets splashed head to bumper.
The new crossing opens and all the friends drive across slowly.
episodes.ending_twist: The fish below splashes Dumpy one more time.

episodes.title: The Lost Little Car
story: A tiny toy-like car character wanders down the wrong forest path.
Beep hears a small worried honk and follows the sound.
Reddy uses his lights while Tracto clears a fallen branch.
The little car is found hiding behind a bush and looks ready to cry.
Everyone escorts him back to Little Kid for a warm happy reunion.
episodes.ending_twist: The little car gives the loudest tiny horn of the whole group.

episodes.title: Mechanic Miku Fixes Beep
story: Beep's tire goes flat on the way to a picnic.
Towy gently brings Beep to Mechanic Miku's workshop.
Miku checks the wheel while Reddy keeps Beep cheerful.
A loose hubcap rolls across the floor and everyone chases it in a silly circle.
Miku fits the repaired tire and Beep drives away smoothly.
episodes.ending_twist: The hubcap rolls back to Miku by itself at the end.

episodes.title: The Runaway Hay Bale
story: Farmer Uncle stacks round hay bales beside the barn.
One bale starts rolling downhill toward the field gate.
Beep races beside it while Tracto takes a shortcut through the grass.
Dumpy positions his empty bed as a soft blocker but gets a face full of hay.
The bale stops safely and everyone laughs at Dumpy's new hay beard.
episodes.ending_twist: Dumpy proudly keeps the hay beard for one second before sneezing it away.

episodes.title: Teamwork Clears the Mountain Road
story: A safe cartoon rockfall blocks the mountain road before morning traffic arrives.
Road Engineer closes the road and gives each vehicle a job.
Tracto pushes smaller rocks, Dumpy carries debris, and Towy moves a stuck branch.
Beep tries to carry one pebble, acts very serious, then drops it with a tiny plop.
Reddy checks the road, the team reopens it, and everyone celebrates at sunset.
episodes.ending_twist: Beep celebrates like he moved the biggest rock.

compilations.title: 6 Big Truck & Car Adventures for Kids | Rescue, Road Building & Farm Fun
